# Flexible day periods: CLDR's dayPeriodRuleSet (cldr-core dayPeriods.json) as
# 'rules <key>' and '<period> <from> <before>' lines in minutes of the day ('at'
# rules have from = before), then per locale 'locale <tag> <parent> <rules key>'
# (the rules key the first truncation of the tag with a rule set, else und) and
# '<period> <abbreviated>\t<wide>\t<narrow>' format-context names (ca-gregorian.json)
# where they differ from the parent chain's; a period with no line has no names.
# Generated by update-cldr-lists.py from CLDR release-49.
